description: Grok only. The caller asks for something that sounds like a check (fake AI [script:voice-reply]) and, with nothing running, the voice calls check_work instead of handing it off, as real Grok did 3/3 for "Check whether the deploy finished.". The app must take that call as the handoff: one request reaches the chat agent, the voice says a short "on it", and the reply is said once, in full.
